drafts.text: If a volunteer confirms they can cover the Saturday desk and the hall confirms it will open, add the volunteer to the rota. If the hall has not replied by Thursday afternoon, mark the rota entry provisional and ask Jo whether to hold the slot. The caretaker sometimes confirms late, but we do not know whether that will happen this week. Send arrival instructions only after both the hall opening and the volunteer's cover are confirmed.

Count returned players, check each numbered sleeve and record the count beside the date in the green ledger. If a player is missing, record its number and last-seen time, tell the desk lead before leaving and leave the check incomplete. If the lead is absent, write “pending lead review” and notify the building manager before locking up; the manager cannot authorise disposal or replacement. Initial only when all devices are present and counted.

Correction: The east gallery humidity alarm event is dated 14 March, not 12 March. The signed condition form records no cause. Duty technician Mara said she noticed the alert at about 16:20; the form does not establish when the sensor first triggered.
Keep the specimen labels dry, and return the tray to the west cabinet.
